### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — Signature unchanged; weighted sum uses OPEN_CONSTANTS.totalBreathScoreWeights (keys timingIn/timingEx/depthIn/depthEx match config.ts:18-23), imported from ../analysis/config, rounded once with Math.round(total * 10) / 10; no intermediate rounding.
- A2: met — New total-score.test.ts asserts 7.5, 7.8 and 7.1 for the three cases. Hand-checked in IEEE doubles: 7.53→7.5, 7.8→7.8, 7.125→7.1.
- A3: met — Asserts 7.3 (7.25, exact in binary) and 7.8 (7.75, exact), and checks that the config weights sum to 1 with toBeCloseTo(1, 10).
- A4: met — The mean helper and the stale JSDoc are removed. Only an import line and the function body are added, with no comments, and no other hunks touch scores.ts.
- A5: unverified — No existing test files are touched. domain.test.ts:26-29 uses whole numbers, which give the same result under both rules. Lint, typecheck and test were not run in this review; the deterministic check stage confirms them.

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._
